source:
@@U02508@@
And every step you take, these halls will follow,
for they are alive,
their very walls teem with life,
darting every which way.
Monsters of the sea
will throng and surge toward the strange, soft glow,
but none will be allowed to enter.
Dragons will sport in your sight,
richly colored, with scales of gold,
and sharks show you their lethal jaws,
and you will laugh in their teeth.
However much your court here may delight you,
you will never have witnessed such grand company.
Nor will you be long parted from what is loveliest.
涅瑞伊得斯海仙女 will come,
curious to see the splendid new dwelling
in the sea’s eternal freshness.
The young will be like fishes,
timid but no less wanton;
the older ones rather more prudent.
忒提斯 will hear the news and come,
proffering her hand and lips to the new 普罗透斯.
And next there’s the seat on the heights of 奥林匹斯山—

@@U02510@@
Thank you, but no.
We ascend that throne soon enough.

@@U02512@@
And as for the earth, Majesty,
you already own that.

@@U02514@@
What stroke of luck brought you here
straight out of the Arabian Nights?
Be as resourceful as Scheherazade
and I assure you the highest of favors.
translation:
@@U02508@@
你迈出的每一步，这些大厅都会跟随，
因为他们还活着，
他们的墙壁充满生机，
到处乱窜。
海里的怪物
将会涌向那奇异而柔和的光芒，
但任何人都不允许进入。
龙将在你的眼前嬉戏，
色彩丰富，有金色的鳞片，
鲨鱼向你展示它们致命的下巴，
你会嘲笑他们的。
无论这里的宫廷多么令你高兴，
你永远不会亲眼目睹如此盛大的公司。
你也不会与最可爱的东西分开太久。
涅瑞伊得斯海仙女会来，
很想看看这座华丽的新住宅
在大海永恒的新鲜中。
少年必如鱼，
胆怯但同样肆意；
年长的人比较谨慎。
忒提斯听到这个消息就会过来，
将她的手和嘴唇伸向新的普罗透斯。
接下来是奥林匹斯山高处的座位——

@@U02510@@
谢谢你，但是不行。
我们很快就会登上那个王位。

@@U02512@@
至于大地，陛下，
你已经拥有它了。

@@U02514@@
是什么运气让你来到这里的
直接从《天方夜谭》中走出来吗？
像山鲁佐德一样足智多谋
我向你保证最崇高的恩惠。
